environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on AWS Lambda via Bref runtime. The Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies a principal condition requiring requests be signed with SigV4 by an IAM role from a specific account (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ReportServiceCaller). The invoke permission uses lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl action with lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType condition key set to AWS_IAM. No public access is possible - unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service layer before reaching application code. CloudWatch metrics confirm zero successful invocations from non-authenticated sources. Additionally, the function runs with a concurrency reservation of 5 to limit blast radius.
